key_highlights: ASX ended the week net higher following an $80b US midterms relief rally, though late momentum moderated.
Iconic department store David Jones entered voluntary administration, triggering acute supply chain and retail property concerns.
Hawkish RBA commentary indicates excess domestic demand and the need for higher unemployment, pushing back rate cut expectations.
Technology outperformed on AI infrastructure momentum led by NextDC (NXT.AX), while NAB (NAB.AX) slumped.
Qantas (QAN.AX) announced fare hikes and flight cuts to absorb a $1 billion surge in fuel costs.

sectors.trend: Strong rally driven by US midterm political relief and sustained AI infrastructure demand.
sectors.implications: Valuation multiples remain well-supported for critical digital infrastructure providers like NextDC (NXT.AX).

sectors.trend: Margin pressure and divergence across major banks highlighted by a sharp sell-off in NAB.
sectors.implications: Tighter borrowing capacities and property market headwinds cloud bank earnings and credit growth (NAB.AX, CBA.AX).

sectors.trend: Severe solvency crisis marked by David Jones collapsing into administration.
sectors.implications: Heightened credit default risk for suppliers and downward pressure on discretionary consumer spending.

sectors.trend: Active equity capital raisings in gold alongside ongoing critical minerals exploration.
sectors.implications: Favourable broker liquidity for junior gold and base metal explorers (BPM, AGC, CHN.AX) amid broader commodity volatility.

sectors.trend: Crude oil prices slumped while aviation contends with substantial fuel cost inflation.
sectors.implications: Upstream revenue headwinds for energy producers (WDS.AX), while Qantas (QAN.AX) exercises capacity discipline to defend yields.

sectors.trend: Mounting tenancy vacancy risks across retail centres and broader housing correction warnings.
sectors.implications: Commercial retail landlords (SCG.AX, VCX.AX) face lease renegotiation risks and potential asset devaluations.

key_themes: Geopolitical and midterm relief rally contrasting structural domestic consumption headwinds.
Commercial retail failures compounding risks across supply chains and property REITs.
Persistent inflation and RBA policy stringency weighing on credit expansion and housing valuations.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Persistent Inflation and Hawkish RBA Stance
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight rate-sensitive consumer discretionary; prioritize defensive yield and high-quality secular growth.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Retail Contagion and Unsecured Supplier Losses
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid exposed retail landlords and scrutinise balance sheets of trade suppliers to distressed department stores.
Trim exposure to highly leveraged mortgage lenders and residential property developers.
Monitor fuel pass-through capability and ticket pricing elasticity in transport holdings (QAN.AX).

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate AI Infrastructure and Cloud Technology
opportunities.rationale: Secular demand for data storage and compute provides earnings durability through macro downturns.

opportunities.recommendation: Targeted Allocation to Gold Explorers and Producers
opportunities.rationale: High equity market liquidity and safe-haven investment demand support gold asset valuations.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Defensive Large-Cap Healthcare and Staples
opportunities.rationale: Inelastic consumer demand offers earnings shelter amidst weakening household purchasing power.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight Retail Landlords and Discretionary Apparel
defensive_moves.rationale: David Jones collapse threatens store vacancies and downward rental rate reversions across shopping centres.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge Exposure to Big Four Australian Banks
defensive_moves.rationale: Intensifying mortgage competition, peaking NIMs, and housing affordability strain indicate earnings downside.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound ASX 200 (^AXJO) consolidation around 8,100–8,300 as global midterm tailwinds meet domestic banking and retail headwinds.
market_outlook.long_term: Defensive rotation favored over 6–12 months as restrictive RBA policy and household debt constraints limit broader index appreciation.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy statement and labor market forecasts
David Jones creditor restructuring and store closure roadmap
US interest rate expectations and geopolitical developments in global oil markets
Australian housing auction clearance rates and dwelling approval data
watch_list: AUD/USD reaction to commodity price shifts and RBA differentials
Major bank net interest margin guidance and arrears metrics
Commercial real estate cap rate adjustments and retail occupancy rates
